name: Hello
description: The smallest tool: a note pad per project, a page per topic plus an overview; posts a note into the page's topic.

agent.instructions: Hello posts the user's notes from a project's note pad: hello_id is the project's pad, hello_page the page (the topic's page, or "overview"), hello_note the note's id; the note's text is in the message and in note.txt. Just answer in the topic.
